note: Fitness and rider training (Spec 3.1, 3.3; Boss 29 and 30 Oct 2026). The gate drop drill (Starts) is offered at the backyard loop (venue): it only gets easier, as if the gate dropped slower, from Starts 70 on (core/training.ts). Each drill is a round of about 40 seconds that can't be failed: finishing it gives its xp whatever the score (Spec 3, Round 122). 50 XP a round is about Tier 1's 4,500 XP an hour (Spec 2.2). walk: Agility for walking about, xp every `tiles` tiles.

drills.name: Bodyweight drills
drills.how: Press Space or tap as the marker crosses the green zone for a good rep. Every round counts, whatever your reps.

drills.name: Gate drop drill
drills.how: Your front wheel at the gate. Watch the gate: press Space or tap the moment it drops. Too early is a jumped start, too late a slow one. Every round counts.

drills.name: Running session
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to run faster, let go to ease off. Keep your pace in the green band for each lap split.
